user.title: Connect Home Assistant to MDtronix
user.description: Could not reach MDtronix. Check your internet connection and select Submit to try again.

waiting.title: Finish in your browser
waiting.description: A tab opened at {verification_uri}, with the code **{user_code}** already filled in. Sign in with Google and select Connect there. This page moves on by itself once you have.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach MDtronix. Check your internet connection and try again.

abort.already_linked: This account already has a connected Home Assistant. Remove the other connection first, or link again with Replace in the browser.
abort.account_suspended: This account is suspended. Contact MDtronix support.
abort.reauth_failed: The integration entry could not be found.
abort.timeout: The code expired after 15 minutes without being approved. Start again.
abort.cannot_connect: Could not reach MDtronix while waiting for approval. Check your internet connection and start again.

loopback_trusted_network.title: Remote access may skip the password
loopback_trusted_network.description: `trusted_networks` in your Home Assistant configuration includes 127.0.0.1. Remote visitors arrive from 127.0.0.1, so they may be treated as trusted and sign in without a password. Remove 127.0.0.1 from `trusted_networks`.

trusted_proxies_missing.title: Remote access needs forwarded client addresses
trusted_proxies_missing.description:
Remote visitors show as 127.0.0.1 in the Home Assistant logs. Add this to `configuration.yaml`, then restart:

```yaml
http:
  use_x_forwarded_for: true
  trusted_proxies:
    - 127.0.0.1
    - ::1
```

remote_access_inactive.title: Remote access is not active
remote_access_inactive.description: This home is offline for remote access because its subscription is not active. Contact MDtronix to renew it. Home Assistant itself keeps working on your local network.

init.title: Voice assistants
init.description: Choose the devices that Google Home and Alexa can control. Each platform has its own list, so a device can be on one, both, or neither. Nothing is exposed until you pick devices. Locks and alarm panels also need the PIN to unlock or disarm by voice.

data.voice_pin: PIN for locks and alarms (4 to 8 digits, or empty to turn it off)

error.invalid_pin: Use 4 to 8 digits, or leave the field empty to turn the PIN off.
